name: target-dossier-reveal
intent: Three redaction bands lift top-to-bottom on a frozen stagger, then the wax seal snaps away to reveal intel.

reducedMotion.behaviour: All bands lifted and seal gone; REVEALED immediately

Seal snaps away after last band (sealMs 160); intel readable as REVEALED

Reduced motion shows all bands lifted and REVEALED immediately
